title: Connect and check your identity
code:
from nomad_sdk import NomadClient

client = NomadClient.from_env()  # NOMAD_API_URL + EnvironmentCredential (NOMAD_PAT)
me = client.users.get_me()
print(f'Authenticated as {me.name} ({me.username})')

title: Connect and check your identity
code:
import os

from nomad_sdk import NomadClient
from nomad_sdk.identity import PersonalAccessTokenCredential

credential = PersonalAccessTokenCredential(os.environ['NOMAD_PAT'])
with NomadClient(os.environ['NOMAD_API_URL'], credential) as client:
    print(client.api_url, '→', client.users.get_me().username)

title: Handle authentication errors
code:
import os

from nomad_sdk import NomadClient
from nomad_sdk.exceptions import AuthenticationError
from nomad_sdk.identity import PersonalAccessTokenCredential

bad = PersonalAccessTokenCredential('not-a-valid-token')
client = NomadClient(os.environ['NOMAD_API_URL'], bad)
try:
    client.users.get_me()
except AuthenticationError as error:
    print(f'Rejected with HTTP {error.status_code}: {error.detail}')

title: Generate a custom workflow archive
code:
from nomad_sdk.workflow import NodeAttributes, NodeAttributesUniverse, NomadWorkflow

nodes = NodeAttributesUniverse(
    nodes={
        0: NodeAttributes(
            name='Geometry optimization',
            type='workflow',
            entry_type='simulation',
            path_info={'mainfile_path': 'Emin/mdrun_Emin.log'},
        ),
        1: NodeAttributes(
            name='Production MD',
            type='workflow',
            entry_type='simulation',
            path_info={'mainfile_path': 'Prod_NVT/mdrun_Prod-NVT.log'},
            in_edge_nodes=[0],
        ),
    }
)

NomadWorkflow(
    node_attributes_universe=nodes,
    name='Two-step MD',
    destination_filename='workflow.archive.yaml',
).build_workflow_yaml()
